exposure: Day of the week (weekday vs. weekend)
outcome: Length of the second stage of labor
cohort: Nulliparous women presenting for delivery over a 2-year period
finding: The length of the second stage of labor in nulliparous women with passive descent varied depending on the time of day and care provider, with longer durations observed during the middle hours of nursing shifts and for physician patients on weekdays.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on the second stage of labor, analyzing its length in relation to various factors.
